errors.evidence: The word "командиран" (dispatched/seconded) is used incorrectly to describe the time range. A more appropriate word would be "обхващащ" (spanning) or simply using "от... до..." (from... to...).

errors.text_span: Диапазонът на стойностите е от 2003 Q3 до 2021 Q1
errors.evidence: The range of the x-axis shown in the figure is from 2003 Q1 to 2021 Q3, not from 2003 Q3 to 2021 Q1.

errors.text_span: Първата линия (синя) започва на около -4% през 2003 Q3
errors.evidence: The line actually starts at approximately +4.0 in 2003 Q1. It never reaches -4% and its value in 2003 Q3 is approximately +2.0.

errors.text_span: достига максимум от около 12% през 2008 Q4
errors.evidence: The line reaches its maximum value of approximately 13.0, not 12%. This peak occurs in 2008 Q3, not 2008 Q4.
In 2010 Q3, the value is approximately 3.0, not 4%. The description also misses the local minimum of approximately 1.0 in 2010 Q1.
In 2013 Q1, the value is approximately +3.5, not -2%. The line does drop to a negative value, but it is approximately -1.5 in 2014 Q3.
The x-axis label shown in the figure for this period is 2017 Q3, not 2017 Q4.

errors.text_span: През 2020 Q2 и 2020 Q3 следва спад до около -2% и -3% съответно.
errors.evidence: The description hallucinates data for 2020 Q2, which is not labeled on the axis. Furthermore, the values are incorrect; in 2020 Q3 the value is approximately +1.5, not -2% or -3%.

errors.text_span: през 2021 Q1 и 2021 Q3 индексът на потребителските цени надвишава 4% и достига около 4,5%
errors.evidence: The values in 2021 are incorrect. In 2021 Q1, the value is at a local minimum of about 0.5. In 2021 Q3, the final point on the graph, the value is approximately 3.0. It does not exceed 4% in 2021.

errors.text_span: Втората линия (червена) започва на около -2% през 2003 Q3 и достига максимум от около 2% през 2004 Q3. След това линията намалява до около -4% през 2007 Q4. През 2009 Q4 линията се покачва до около 0%, след което продължава да намалява до около -3% през 2013 Q1. През 2016 Q4 линията се покачва до около 1% и остава на това ниво през 2021 Q1 и 2021 Q3.
